claim: Izmir is Turkey's third-largest city
source_quote: Izmir, Turkey's third-largest city, has become one of the most attractive destinations for foreign real estate investors seeking Turkish citizenship by investment.

claim: Turkey's CBI programme requires minimum property purchase of $400,000 USD held for three years
source_quote: Turkey's citizenship-by-investment programme requires a minimum property purchase of $400,000 USD, held for three years.

claim: Karşıyaka property prices range from $2,500 to $4,500 per square meter
source_quote: Property prices here range from $2,500 to $4,500 per square meter depending on proximity to the waterfront and building age.

claim: Karşıyaka gross rental yields of 4-6% are achievable
source_quote: The rental market is active, with gross yields of 4-6% achievable in established buildings.

claim: Key streets in Karşıyaka are Alaybey, Bostanlı, and Cemal Gürsel
source_quote: Key streets to focus on: Alaybey and Bostanlı areas for waterfront proximity, Cemal Gürsel for quieter residential streets.

claim: Bornova property prices are 20-30% below Karşıyaka
source_quote: Property prices are 20-30% below Karşıyaka, making it the strongest value play for investors who prioritize square footage and rental yield over prestige.

claim: Bornova property prices range from $1,800 to $3,000 per square meter
source_quote: Prices range from $1,800 to $3,000 per square meter.

claim: Bornova gross rental yields are 5-7%
source_quote: Gross rental yields tend to be 5-7%, higher than Karşıyaka because purchase prices are lower while rents are only marginally so.

claim: Ege University is Izmir's largest university
source_quote: It has the city's largest university (Ege University), multiple shopping centers, and direct metro access to the city center.

claim: Bornova has direct metro access to the city center
source_quote: It has the city's largest university (Ege University), multiple shopping centers, and direct metro access to the city center.

claim: Konak renovated apartments near Kordon command $3,500-5,000/sqm
source_quote: Property here is a mixed bag: renovated apartments near the Kordon command premium prices ($3,500-5,000/sqm)

claim: Buildings behind the bazaar in Konak can be found for under $2,000/sqm
source_quote: while buildings in the older neighborhoods behind the bazaar can be found for under $2,000/sqm but often come with structural issues and limited renovation potential.

claim: Bayraklı property values have been appreciating 15-20% annually in some buildings
source_quote: property values have been appreciating faster than any other district (15-20% annually in some buildings).

claim: Bayraklı prices range from $2,500 to $4,000/sqm in newer developments
source_quote: Prices range from $2,500 to $4,000/sqm in newer developments.

claim: Urla property prices are under $1,500/sqm in many areas
source_quote: Urla has become Turkey's wine country, with property prices still under $1,500/sqm in many areas.

claim: Seferihisar is a designated 'slow city' (cittaslow)
source_quote: Seferihisar is a designated 'slow city' (cittaslow) with organic markets and a relaxed coastal lifestyle.

claim: Izmir sits on a fault line
source_quote: Izmir sits on a fault line. Buildings constructed before 2000 may not meet current seismic codes.

claim: Post-2000 buildings must have earthquake insurance (DASK)
source_quote: Post-2000 buildings must have earthquake insurance (DASK), which is a good proxy for structural compliance.

claim: Closing costs should be budgeted at 8-10% above purchase price
source_quote: Budget 8-10% above purchase price for closing costs

claim: Title deed transfer tax is 4%
source_quote: 4% title deed transfer tax, notary fees, translator fees, and agent commission.

claim: CBI programme requires transfer through banking system
source_quote: Open a Turkish bank account — required for the $400,000 transfer that the CBI programme mandates go through the banking system.

claim: Turkey Ministry of Environment and Urbanisation is a source
source_quote: Turkey Ministry of Environment and Urbanisation — CBI programme requirements

claim: Turkish Statistical Institute (TÜİK) is a source
source_quote: Turkish Statistical Institute (TÜİK) — Izmir property price index

claim: Reidin-GYODER Turkey Real Estate Market Reports is a source
source_quote: Reidin-GYODER Turkey Real Estate Market Reports

claim: kat mülkiyeti means condominium ownership
source_quote: Always verify the tapu is kat mülkiyeti (condominium ownership) not kat irtifakı (construction servitude)

claim: kat irtifakı means construction servitude indicating incomplete permits
source_quote: kat irtifakı (construction servitude), which indicates incomplete permits.

claim: imar durumu means zoning status
source_quote: Your lawyer must confirm the imar durumu (zoning status) before you commit.

claim: yeminli tercüman means sworn translator
source_quote: Use a sworn translator (yeminli tercüman) for all documents.

claim: vergi numarası means Turkish tax number
source_quote: Obtain a Turkish tax number (vergi numarası) before any transaction.

claim: Gecekondu means squatter areas
source_quote: Gecekondu (squatter) areas: Some districts have informal settlements that have been regularized but carry title deed complications.

claim: After three years you can sell and retain citizenship under CBI programme
source_quote: After three years, you can sell and retain citizenship.

claim: Alsancak is a sub-neighborhood with the city's best nightlife, dining, and walkability
source_quote: The strategic play in Konak is targeting the Alsancak sub-neighborhood, which has the city's best nightlife, dining, and walkability.
